summary: YPF Sociedad Anónima filed a 6-K reporting its Board's approval of an issuer tender offer to repurchase up to AR$38,468,000,000 of its own Class D shares (max 10% of capital stock) at up to AR$108,160/share on the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange and US$72.95/ADR on NYSE. The repurchase is for share compensation plans, funded from a reserve of AR$38.468 billion approved at the April 30, 2026 shareholder meeting. Daily purchase limit is 25% of 90-day average trading volume. The 90-day window starts after publication on CNV and ByMA websites. A share split (10:1 par value reduction) is pending implementation and will adjust prices accordingly. As of June 3, 2026, 392,075,056 shares were outstanding. Watch for execution pace and the split's impact on price thresholds; no advisor named.
